overreach.why: Điều 27 khoản 2 bans use of images, equipment, attire, names or letters of medical units, doctors, pharmacists and staff, plus patient thank-you letters and their articles. 'May not use doctors, pharmacists or medical facilities' drops those instruments and reads wider than the clause.
